name: Food Empire Holdings Limited
summary: Food Empire Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company. It offers instant coffee, tea, hot chocolate, and snack food products under the MacCoffee, CaféPH?, Petrovskaya Sloboda, Klassno, Hillway, Kracks, MacTea, MacCereal, MacChocolate, MacChoco, CaféRite, NutriRite, FesAroma, Melosa, Assam, Nauryz, Simba, and Indira brand names.
